dedupe_keys.name: temoaproject energy storage options for north carolina

description: Joseph DeCarolis and colleagues publish Temoa code and data for the Energy Storage Options for North Carolina study. Capacity-expansion runs estimate the state’s 2030 generation mix. Their installed capacities are then fixed in operational runs that assess storage for bulk energy time shifting and peak-capacity deferral. The source distinguishes 96 annual time slices in the capacity model from 8,760 hourly slices in the operational model. Inputs include text SQL and DAT files, with scenario configuration files and the associated Temoa source snapshot supplied in two ZIP archives. Zenodo provides free open access and declares LGPL-2.0-or-later for the deposit. The related Temoa record describes the modelling tool; this record covers the study-specific data bundle. A limitation is that the metadata does not enumerate all scenario assumptions or measured validation data. Files and model execution were not checked, so the reported workflow does not establish a successful reproduction.
